turns.question: Between 1 and 10 October 2026, how many euros less did a first-time buyer's order come to, on average, than a returning customer's?
turns.answer: The semantic layer has no such metric: average order value cannot be split into first-time buyers versus returning customers, because no dimension separates an order by whether it was the customer's first. The closest metrics are average_order_value_eur (all non-cancelled orders), revenue_repeat_customers_eur, repeat_revenue_share and repeat_customers, but none gives the average order of first-time buyers against returning customers, so I cannot give that euro difference.
